decision: Keep the CFTC/Deribit XRP collateral route as a conditional capability, not a confirmed Coinbase usage event. Apply period-aware evidence and custody-status checks.
rules: Use Coinbase Q3 2026 Form 10-Q as a September 30 cutoff: recognized derivatives collateral is BTC and ETH only, total $325.766M; no XRP line.
Do not attribute the $1.2995B broad crypto-assets-held-as-collateral balance to XRP or Deribit.
Do not attribute the $2.804112B unrecognized customer crypto lending collateral to derivatives margin or XRP.
Keep corporate assets pledged against short-term borrowings separate from customer collateral.
The Q3 period ends before the October 1 Coinbase/Deribit integration completion; absence of XRP at September 30 does not disprove post-integration use.

Deribit's October 14 custody policy lists Coinbase Custody Trust Company in cold custody but still describes CBBM as a future warm-wallet addition; require a later policy revision or direct operational evidence before marking CBBM custody live.

Require CFM notice date, first-three-month restriction expiry, customer agreement/consent, account-level collateral mode and post-integration balances before admitting actual XRP collateral as a feature.
Keep venue eligibility, custody capability, legal no-action scope and actual collateral balances as separate graph edges and model features.
